localIncomeTax.note: Georgia state flat income tax rate. House Bill 463 lowered the rate from 5.19% to 4.99% for 2026, with a path to 3.99%.

localSalesTax.note: TODO: State rate confirmed at 4%. Local county/city/MARTA rates (Fulton County portion) not yet verified. See Georgia DOR rate chart for full Atlanta jurisdiction rate.

propertyLevies.note: TODO: UNVERIFIED. Atlanta city rate (11.4 mills) is sum of Operating (8.52) + Bonds (1.88) + Parks (1.00). Fulton County is FY2026 proposed rate. APS rate is 20.5 mills (maintained since 2022). Special Service District (Beltline commercial, 2.0 mills) applies to specific taxpayers only.

value.name: City of Atlanta Basic Homestead Exemption
value.eligibility: Legal resident of the City of Atlanta; must own and occupy home as of January 1.

value.name: Atlanta Public Schools Homestead Exemption
value.eligibility: Reduces assessed value for APS taxes. May be combined with other APS exemptions.

localExemptions.note: TODO: City of Atlanta Base Freeze Exemption caps annual value increase at 2.6%. Additional senior/disability exemptions exist with income limits. Fulton County School District (outside APS) has separate new exemptions (25%/50% for age 65/70).

supplementalDistricts.note: Special Service District levy (2.00 mills) applies to commercial projects in the Atlanta Beltline district. Numerous Tax Allocation Districts (TADs) exist (Atlantic Station, Beltline, Stadium, etc.) and are PARCEL-SPECIFIC. Check individual property.
